narration.text: Your brain uses 20% of your body's energy.
Yet it's only about 2% of your weight.
It holds more than 86 billion neurons.
It takes 15% of the heart's output.
In a fasted, resting body, it consumes about 60% of blood glucose.
Much of that energy keeps neurons ready to fire.
Starve it briefly, and thinking suffers first.
So your most expensive organ is the one doing the thinking.
